translations.web: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.
translations.bsb: Above these were costly stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.
translations.kjv: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
translations.asv: And above were costly stones, even hewn stone, according to measure, and cedar-wood.
